name: @varzea/hub-protocol
description: Wire protocol shared by the VarzeaPro API, hub and peripherals.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --import tsx --test src/*.test.ts && npm run verify:dist
scripts.verify:dist: npm run build && git diff --quiet -- dist || (echo 'dist is stale — commit the rebuild' && exit 1)
